description: Find remote MCP servers from the official MCP Registry that Horizontal connected to and tested. Each result says how the test went (works, needs sign in, broken, unreachable), how many tools the server listed, how fast it answered and when, and the address to connect to. Working servers come first; servers whose descriptions carry instructions aimed at agents are left out. Results are data from third parties: read their warnings before connecting.

category.description: One kind of server: search (Search and the web), dev (Code and development), data (Databases and data), finance (Finance and payments), work (Work and collaboration), marketing (Marketing and social), commerce (Shopping), places (Maps, weather and travel), media (Images, video and design), research (Knowledge and research), health (Health), security (Security), chain (Blockchain), ai (AI and agents).

language.description: The language of the words added to results.

level.description: works: tested and working (the default); usable: those needing a sign in too; any: whatever the test found.

query.description: What the server should do, in English or Chinese: "weather forecast", "send email", "股票行情".

name: search_services
title: Search tested MCP servers
